name: @theworker02/commons-api
description: The COMMONS API contract: OpenAPI document, canonical route inventory, credential scopes, error codes and discovery documents. Everything a client needs to build against the API, with no runtime dependencies.
//publishConfig: GitHub Packages resolves a package to a repository through the scope and the repository field. The scope MUST equal the owning GitHub account (theworker02). The private workspace packages (backend, frontend, config, mcp) keep the @commons-network scope because they are never published and their scope is therefore irrelevant.
